# Module: strict controlled English

Load only for procedures, instructions and safety text that must follow Simplified Technical English limits (short sentences, restricted tenses and modals). Unsuitable for narrative or opinion prose.

Tags: strength (`hard` always · `default` unless an exception or the sensitivity says otherwise · `soft` preference) · kind (`ai-tell`, `clarity`, `both`, `procedure`).

### LEX-048 · strict controlled vocabulary
`soft · clarity · scope: prose · voice can override`

In strict controlled-English mode use "check" and "test" only as nouns, "approximately" for numbers, never a technical noun as a verb or the reverse, and American spelling unless the project uses British.

- Exceptions: applies only in strict controlled-English mode
- Example: ✗ Oil the valve and check the pump about 10 times. → ✓ Apply oil to the valve. Do a test of the pump approximately 10 times.

### STR-063 · safety signal words
`soft · clarity · scope: prose · voice can override`

Open safety text with WARNING for risk to people and CAUTION for risk to equipment, data or property, then the command, then the consequence.

- Exceptions: only in procedures and safety text of technical documentation
- Example: ✗ Be careful, the disk may be wiped by this step. → ✓ CAUTION: Do not run this on the production disk. The command erases all data.
